title: Lost in Recovery: Demystifying Recovery Behavior of Computer-Use Agents via Goal-Oriented Action Replay
title_zh: 迷失于恢复：通过面向目标的动作重放揭示计算机使用代理的恢复行为

paragraphs.en: Recent advances in large (vision) language models have enabled computer-use agents that automate digital workflows via fine-grained keyboard and mouse operations. However, such agents remain fragile in long-horizon settings, where errors accumulate and executed actions leave unintended side effects, making the ability to recover from failures critical. Yet, existing remedies remain inadequate: environment resets are infeasible in proprietary settings, action replay is prohibitively expensive over long horizons, and API-based rollback is limited to web environments, leaving model-based recovery largely unexplored. To address this gap, we present ReTrace , a scalable evaluation framework for systematically studying recovery behavior in computer-use agents. We formalize Transition-Consistent Recovery : identical downstream actions from the recovered and target states must yield identical outcomes. We operationalize this criterion through goal-oriented action replay following controlled error injection. Using ReTrace , we present the first systematic study of autonomous, model-based recovery, revealing that (i) ideal recovery can unlock model’s latent task completion capabilities, (ii) current computer-use agents fail to exploit their latent recovery capabilities, and (iii) accurate model-based recovery yields measurable end-to-end gains. Together, these findings establish recovery as a fundamental capability for building reliable computer-use agents. Our code and dataset is available at https://github.com/BangProx/ReTRACE .

paragraphs.en: The digital computing environment has become the primary interface through which users interact with software, supporting a wide spectrum of tasks ranging from simple actions (e.g., website logins) to complex workflows (document editing). paragraphs.en: However, computer-use agents remain fragile in long-horizon and sophisticated tasks, where early mistakes accumulate and propagate across subsequent steps ( Wang et al., 2026a ) , and where executed actions may leave unintended side effects that should not have occurred (e.g., an agent organizing a directory may complete the task but silently overwrite files that the user wanted to keep). As a result, the ability to revert the environment to a previously intact state is critical for reliable operation. To address this, prior work explores two directions: inducing self-reflective behaviors through textual feedback or parameter updates from reward signals that refine forward actions ( Chae et al., 2025a ; Chae et al., 2025b ; Wu et al., 2025b ; Wang et al., 2025a ; Zhang et al., 2026a ; Xue et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026c ) , and explicit test-time rollback through full environment resets followed by re-executing all prior actions (i.e., action replay) ( Koh et al., 2024b ; He et al., 2025 ) or API-based undo operations in web environments (e.g., browser back) ( Hu et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ) , utilized as a heuristic component within an inference pipeline rather than subjected to systematic study.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，计算机使用智能体在长程且复杂的任务中仍然脆弱，早期错误会在后续步骤中累积并传播（ Wang et al., 2026a ），且执行的动作可能留下不应发生的意外副作用（例如，一个整理目录的智能体可能完成任务，却悄悄覆盖了用户想保留的文件）。 因此，将环境回退到先前完好状态的能力对于可靠运行至关重要。 为解决这一问题，先前的工作探索了两个方向：一是通过文本反馈或来自奖励信号的参数更新来诱导自我反思行为，从而改进前向动作（ Chae et al., 2025a ; Chae et al., 2025b ; Wu et al., 2025b ; Wang et al., 2025a ; Zhang et al., 2026a ; Xue et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026c ）；二是通过完整的环境重置并重新执行所有先前的动作（即动作重放）进行显式的测试时回滚（ Koh et al., 2024b ; He et al., 2025 ），或在网页环境中使用基于 API 的撤销操作（例如浏览器后退）（ Hu et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ），这些方法仅作为推理流程中的启发式组件，而未受到系统性研究。

paragraphs.en: To address this, we introduce ReTrace , a pipeline that conducts the first systematic study of autonomous, model-based recovery behavior in computer-use agents. Motivated by predictive state representation theory ( Littman and Sutton, 2001 ) , which represents states by the formalization of predicted futures, we formalize successful recovery as Transition-Consistent Recovery : a recovered state matches its target if executing identical downstream actions from both states yields identical outcomes. This formulation captures latent changes beyond visual similarity by leveraging behavioral equivalence, operationalized via goal-oriented action replay . Specifically, we replay each on-policy trajectory multiple times and retain only those with consistent successful outcomes, ensuring deterministic environment transitions. From these trajectories, we sample intermediate states as recovery targets, perturb them into erroneous states, and evaluate whether the original task outcome can be reproduced by replaying the remaining actions.
paragraphs.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提出了 ReTrace，这是首个针对计算机使用智能体中自主的、基于模型的恢复行为进行系统性研究的流水线。 受预测状态表征理论（Littman and Sutton, 2001）的启发——该理论通过对预测未来的形式化来表征状态——我们将成功恢复形式化为转移一致恢复：如果从两个状态执行相同的下游动作会产生相同的结果，则恢复后的状态与其目标状态匹配。 这一形式化通过利用行为等价性（经由面向目标的动作重放来实现），捕捉了超出视觉相似性之外的潜在变化。 具体而言，我们将每条同策略轨迹重放多次，仅保留那些具有一致成功结果的轨迹，从而确保确定性的环境转移。 从这些轨迹中，我们采样中间状态作为恢复目标，将其扰动为错误状态，并通过重放剩余动作来评估能否复现原始任务结果。

paragraphs.en: We then instantiate ReTrace on OSWorld ( Xie et al., 2024 ) and WindowsAgentArena ( Bonatti et al., 2024 ) across closed- and open-source computer-use agents, and find that recovery plays a critical role in reliable agent operation. We first show that ideal recovery, in which agents are returned to an oracle prior state, boosts performance over naive environment resets (Section 4 ), identifying recovery as the key lever for unlocking agents’ latent task-solving capacity ( RQ1 ) . Yet current agents leave this lever unused, lacking both the tendency and capability to recover autonomously (Section 5 ) ( RQ2 ) . When equipped with explicit model-based recovery, however, recovery success climbs by more than an order of magnitude, revealing that the underlying capability is latent rather than absent (Section 5 ) (RQ2) . Moreover, recovery quality in turn translates into downstream task success: accurate model-level recovery delivers measurable end-to-end gains by unlocking otherwise latent task-solving capacity, while weak recovery can actively derail the trajectory ( RQ3 ) (Section 6 ) . These findings position accurate model-based recovery, together with reliable continuation from the recovered state, as a key step toward stronger computer-use agents.
paragraphs.zh: 随后，我们在 OSWorld（Xie et al., 2024）和 WindowsAgentArena（Bonatti et al., 2024）上，针对闭源与开源的计算机操作智能体对 ReTrace 进行了实例化，发现恢复在智能体的可靠运行中起着关键作用。 我们首先证明，理想恢复——即智能体被回退到一个先知的先前状态——的性能优于朴素的环境重置（第 4 节），从而确认恢复是释放智能体潜在任务解决能力的关键杠杆（RQ1）。 然而，当前的智能体并未使用这一杠杆，既缺乏自主恢复的倾向，也缺乏相应的能力（第 5 节）（RQ2）。 但是，当配备显式的基于模型的恢复机制后，恢复成功率提升了一个数量级以上，这表明该底层能力是潜在的而非缺失的（第 5 节）（RQ2）。 此外，恢复质量会进一步转化为下游任务的成功：准确的模型级恢复通过释放原本潜在的任务解决能力带来了可测量的端到端收益，而糟糕的恢复则可能主动使轨迹偏离正轨（RQ3）（第 6 节）。 这些发现将准确的基于模型的恢复，以及从恢复状态出发的可靠延续，定位为构建更强计算机操作智能体的关键一步。

sents.en: We then instantiate ReTrace on OSWorld ( Xie et al., 2024 ) and WindowsAgentArena ( Bonatti et al., 2024 ) across closed- and open-source computer-use agents, and find that recovery plays a critical role in reliable agent operation.
sents.zh: 随后，我们在 OSWorld（Xie et al., 2024）和 WindowsAgentArena（Bonatti et al., 2024）上，针对闭源与开源的计算机操作智能体对 ReTrace 进行了实例化，发现恢复在智能体的可靠运行中起着关键作用。

sents.en: We first show that ideal recovery, in which agents are returned to an oracle prior state, boosts performance over naive environment resets (Section 4 ), identifying recovery as the key lever for unlocking agents’ latent task-solving capacity ( RQ1 ) .
sents.zh: 我们首先证明，理想恢复——即智能体被回退到一个先知的先前状态——的性能优于朴素的环境重置（第 4 节），从而确认恢复是释放智能体潜在任务解决能力的关键杠杆（RQ1）。

sents.en: Yet current agents leave this lever unused, lacking both the tendency and capability to recover autonomously (Section 5 ) ( RQ2 ) .
sents.zh: 然而，当前的智能体并未使用这一杠杆，既缺乏自主恢复的倾向，也缺乏相应的能力（第 5 节）（RQ2）。

sents.en: When equipped with explicit model-based recovery, however, recovery success climbs by more than an order of magnitude, revealing that the underlying capability is latent rather than absent (Section 5 ) (RQ2) .
sents.zh: 但是，当配备显式的基于模型的恢复机制后，恢复成功率提升了一个数量级以上，这表明该底层能力是潜在的而非缺失的（第 5 节）（RQ2）。

sents.en: Moreover, recovery quality in turn translates into downstream task success: accurate model-level recovery delivers measurable end-to-end gains by unlocking otherwise latent task-solving capacity, while weak recovery can actively derail the trajectory ( RQ3 ) (Section 6 ) .
sents.zh: 此外，恢复质量会进一步转化为下游任务的成功：准确的模型级恢复通过释放原本潜在的任务解决能力带来了可测量的端到端收益，而糟糕的恢复则可能主动使轨迹偏离正轨（RQ3）（第 6 节）。

sents.en: These findings position accurate model-based recovery, together with reliable continuation from the recovered state, as a key step toward stronger computer-use agents.

paragraphs.en: Computer-use agents aim to complete diverse user tasks across web-based environments ( Gur et al., 2023 ; Furuta et al., 2023 ; OpenAI, 2025 ; Awadallah et al., 2025 ) , desktop operating systems such as Linux and Windows ( Wang et al., 2025b ; Yang et al., 2025 ; Anthropic, 2026 ) , and mobile environments ( Ye et al., 2025a ; Xu et al., 2026 ) . Pioneering works leverage LLMs over HTML DOM content ( Liu et al., 2018 ; Kim et al., 2023 ; Zhou et al., 2023 ) , while recent studies operate LVLMs over screenshot observations ( Koh et al., 2024a ; Bai et al., 2025 ; Kim et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026c ) and further reinforce backbone capabilities through reinforcement learning ( Wang et al., 2025a ; Xu et al., 2025 ; Xue et al., 2026 ) or external memories ( Zheng et al., 2023 ; Fu et al., 2024 ) . However, these efforts concentrate on strengthening the forward decision policy, leaving long-horizon brittleness, where early mistakes accumulate and propagate downstream ( Wang et al., 2026a ) , largely unaddressed. In contrast, we focus on the systematic analysis of recovery behavior in computer-use agents, a complementary but underexplored axis.

paragraphs.en: Prior work explores diverse error-handling strategies across complex interactive tasks. For example, Lightman et al. (2024) ; Shinn et al. (2023) ; Xi et al. (2024) use outcome and process-level feedback to refine actions at test time in mathematical and code tasks ( Chen et al., 2022 ) . In long-horizon embodied settings, Huang et al. (2022) ; Wang et al. (2023a) ; Wang et al. (2023b) leverage external rewards to revise plans or acquire new skills, and Li et al. (2025) perform rollback through resetting the environment and executing identical actions. This problem has also been explored in computer-use agents: Wang et al. (2024) ; Chae et al. (2025b) ; Wu et al. (2025b) use external verifiers to induce reflective behaviors ( Hu et al., 2025 ) for effective user task completion, Koh et al. (2024b) ; He et al. (2025) employ action replay to revert to prior states upon failure, and Hu et al. (2025) ; Zhang et al. (2026b) utilize explicit rollback via go-back operations in Playwright, while Lu et al. (2026) introduce semantic actions for state recovery within the DFS algorithm. However, previous works used these mechanisms as heuristics in inference pipelines rather than systematically analyzing their behavior and effects. In contrast, we uncover key findings on model-level recovery in computer-use agents using ReTrace , a scalable pipeline enabling the first systematic analysis of recovery behavior.

paragraphs.en: Agents exhibit diverse trajectories across repeated rollouts of the same task, and this variance may imply substantial latent task-solving capability that any single rollout fails to exploit, motivating our hypothesis: reverting to an appropriate past state ( recovery step ) can convert it into task success. To validate this, we measure Success@5, the success rate over 5 independent continuations, when the forward policy resumes from different recovery steps.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体在同一个任务的多次重复执行中表现出多样的轨迹，这种差异可能意味着存在大量未被单次执行所利用的潜在任务解决能力，由此引出我们的假设：回退到合适的过往状态（恢复步骤）可以将其转化为任务成功。 为验证这一点，我们测量 Success@5，即从前向策略从不同恢复步骤恢复后的 5 次独立续算的成功率。

sents.en: Agents exhibit diverse trajectories across repeated rollouts of the same task, and this variance may imply substantial latent task-solving capability that any single rollout fails to exploit, motivating our hypothesis: reverting to an appropriate past state ( recovery step ) can convert it into task success.

sents.en: To validate this, we measure Success@5, the success rate over 5 independent continuations, when the forward policy resumes from different recovery steps.

Whether this mapping succeeds is judged by a predefined recovery oracle ℛ \mathcal{R} , which returns a binary indicator of recovery success or failure, ℛ ⁡ ( f ⁡ ( s t ) , s target ) ∈ { 0 , 1 } \mathcal{R}(f(s_{t}),s_{\mathrm{target}})\in\{0,1\} . Recalling from Section 3 that each state decomposes as s t = ( h t , o t ) s_{t}=(h_{t},o_{t}) into a hidden component h t h_{t} and an observation o t o_{t} , ℛ \mathcal{R} should verify that f ⁡ ( s t ) f(s_{t}) matches s target s_{\mathrm{target}} in both components. A natural instantiation of ℛ \mathcal{R} is to compare the observations of f ⁡ ( s t ) f(s_{t}) and s target s_{\mathrm{target}} directly, e.g., via pixel- or feature-level matching. paragraphs.en: ReTrace evaluates recovery in three stages (Figure 2 ): the first two construct a transition-consistent evaluation set, and the third measures recovery on it via goal-oriented action replay.
paragraphs.zh: ReTrace 分三个阶段评估恢复能力（图 2）：前两个阶段构建一个转移一致性的评估集，第三个阶段通过面向目标的动作重放在该评估集上衡量恢复能力。

paragraphs.en: As the first stage of ReTrace (Figure 2 (A)), evaluating transition-consistent recovery requires a target state s target s_{\mathrm{target}} and an error state s error s_{\mathrm{error}} for a trajectory τ \tau , together with a deterministic transition function 𝒯 \mathcal{T} . To probe each policy on its own behavior, τ \tau must remain on-policy with the evaluated π θ \pi_{\theta} . paragraphs.en: We evaluate a range of state-of-the-art computer-use agents. paragraphs.en: We now present and analyze the recovery evaluation results across both benchmarks and all agents.
paragraphs.zh: 我们现在给出并分析两个基准测试以及所有智能体的恢复评估结果。

paragraphs.en: Our results in Figures 4 and 5 show that even the strongest computer-use agents, Claude-Sonnet-4.6 and GPT-5.4-CUA, have limited recovery capability, while the strongest open-source model, EvoCUA-32B, exhibits a near-complete inability to restore previous states, with an average recovery rate below 1%. This suggests that current forward policies lack both the intrinsic capability and the behavioral tendency to autonomously perform restorative actions under failure (Finding 2) . The analysis in Figure 6 reinforces this: rationales generated during implicit recovery show substantially lower similarity to the ground-truth recovery prompts, indicating that agents rarely even attempt recovery.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在图 4 和图 5 中的结果表明，即使是最强的计算机使用智能体 Claude-Sonnet-4.6 和 GPT-5.4-CUA，其恢复能力也很有限，而最强的开源模型 EvoCUA-32B 则几乎完全无法恢复先前的状态，平均恢复率低于 1%。 这表明当前的向前策略既缺乏在失败时自主执行恢复动作的内在能力，也缺乏相应的行为倾向（发现 2）。 图 6 中的分析进一步印证了这一点：隐式恢复过程中生成的推理依据与真实恢复提示的相似度明显较低，说明智能体甚至很少尝试恢复。

paragraphs.en: The results in Figures 4 and 5 further show that explicit model-based recovery substantially outperforms implicit recovery, by an average margin of 17.86% across the Linux and Windows environments. In addition, the largest improvements are observed for generalist computer-use agents, such as Claude-Sonnet-4.6, GPT-5.4-CUA, and Qwen-3.5-9B. These results suggest that the recovery capability of current computer-use agents is latent rather than absent, but such capabilities are not effectively elicited during standard forward task execution (Finding 3) . In contrast, the gains are considerably smaller for post-trained open-source agents, suggesting that extensive post-training on one-directional task-completion trajectories may weaken their inherent recovery capability (Finding 4) . Figure 7 shows the same trend in long-horizon settings: generalist agents exhibit substantially greater recovery potential, whereas post-trained specialists consistently struggle with explicit recovery. Nevertheless, even the most capable models combined with basic explicit recovery strategies still fail to achieve complete recovery under our evaluation settings, suggesting that substantial research remains in developing more robust recovery mechanisms for computer-use agents.

paragraphs.en: To assess how reliably ReTrace judges recovery success, we conduct a human evaluation study against three baselines: two ablations of our oracle ℛ \mathcal{R} with either the image-wise matching component ℛ O \mathcal{R}_{O} or the transition-consistent component ℛ TC \mathcal{R}_{\mathrm{TC}} removed, and GPT-5.4, a state-of-the-art model with extensive computer-use knowledge. We recruit 12 annotators to judge whether each recovered state aligns with the target state, with 50 samples per variant and each annotator rating 25 of them. As shown in Table 1 , ReTrace agrees with human judgments more often than all baselines, including GPT-5.4, confirming the reliability of its recovery oracle ℛ \mathcal{R} . We further report an average inter-annotator agreement of 82% and a Cohen’s kappa ( Cohen, 1960 ) of 0.45, indicating reliable agreement.

paragraphs.en: To validate the potential benefits of model-based recovery, we analyze its performance gains across diverse recovery settings. paragraphs.en: In this paper, we conducted the first systematic study of autonomous, model-level recovery behavior in computer-use agents through ReTrace , a scalable pipeline that formalizes successful restoration as Transition-Consistent Recovery , where a recovered state matches its target if identical downstream actions yield identical outcomes, and operationalizes this via goal-oriented action replay . Empirical evaluations across closed and open-source agents reveal that current agents lack both the tendency and capability to recover autonomously, while accurate model-based recovery substantially closes this gap and translates into measurable end-to-end gains, despite characteristic failure modes such as spurious perception and state-tracking errors. We believe these findings position accurate model-based recovery as a key step toward reliable computer-use agents.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们通过 ReTrace 对计算机使用智能体的自主模型级恢复行为进行了首个系统性研究。ReTrace 是一个可扩展的流程，它将成功的恢复形式化为「转移一致恢复」，即若相同的下游动作产生相同的结果，则恢复后的状态与其目标状态匹配，并通过面向目标的动作重放来实现这一概念。 在闭源与开源智能体上的实证评估表明，当前的智能体既缺乏自主恢复的倾向，也缺乏相应的能力；而准确的基于模型的恢复能显著缩小这一差距，并转化为可衡量的端到端收益，尽管仍存在虚假感知和状态跟踪错误等典型的失败模式。 我们相信，这些发现表明准确的基于模型的恢复是迈向可靠计算机使用智能体的关键一步。

paragraphs.en: ReTrace is designed to measure and analyze recovery capabilities and behaviors rather than to directly improve them. Our explicit recovery settings can only elicit capabilities already present in the underlying model and cannot compensate for fundamental deficiencies in GUI understanding, state tracking, or action planning. Consequently, inaccurate recovery by specialist agents with weaker recovery capabilities may induce additional trajectory drift and reduce task success. Potential directions for addressing this gap include recovery-aware post-training on erroneous states, target states, and corresponding corrective action trajectories, as well as auxiliary objectives for tracking latent environment states and predicting action-induced transitions. ReTrace can provide the evaluation protocol and controlled recovery scenarios needed to develop and assess such methods, but designing and validating them is beyond the scope of the present work.
paragraphs.zh: ReTrace 旨在度量和分析恢复能力与恢复行为，而非直接改进它们。 我们的显式恢复设置只能激发底层模型中已有的能力，无法弥补在 GUI 理解、状态跟踪或动作规划方面的根本性缺陷。 因此，恢复能力较弱的专业智能体在恢复不准确时可能会引发额外的轨迹漂移，降低任务成功率。 解决这一差距的潜在方向包括：在错误状态、目标状态及相应纠正动作轨迹上进行恢复感知的后训练，以及用于跟踪潜在环境状态和预测动作引起的状态转移的辅助目标。 ReTrace 可以提供开发和评估此类方法所需的评估协议与受控恢复场景，但设计和验证这些方法超出了本文的范围。

paragraphs.en: Our work aims to advance the reliability of computer-use agents by systematically studying their recovery behavior, contributing positively to the safe and dependable deployment of digital automation. However, we acknowledge the dual-use nature of such research, as more capable agents could in principle be repurposed for harmful automation. To mitigate such risks, we conduct all experiments in sandboxed virtual environments using publicly available benchmarks in accordance with their licenses, without interaction with real user accounts or personal data, and recommend pairing deployments with appropriate safeguards.

paragraphs.en: We primarily leverage two publicly available benchmarks consisting of both web tasks and non-web tasks: OSWorld 1 1 1 https://github.com/xlang-ai/OSWorld.git ( Xie et al., 2024 ) , released under the Apache License 2.0, and WindowsAgentArena ( Bonatti et al., 2024 ) , released under the MIT License. Both benchmarks consist of non-web tasks with significantly higher ratio compared to web-based tasks, which we demonstrate such ratio in Table 5 that underscores the importance of model-level recovery, where web-based apis such as Playwright is not supported. To accelerate evaluation, we execute multiple environments in parallel, and for WindowsAgentArena, we utilize the processed environments provided by OS-Symphony 2 2 2 https://github.com/OS-Copilot/OS-Symphony.git ( Yang et al., 2026 ) , released under the Apache License 2.0, to enable efficient large-scale evaluation set construction. Our use of these artifacts is consistent with their intended use as public benchmark and evaluation resources. We deploy all environments within isolated Docker containers and apply a 10-second post-action settle window to ensure that pending UI updates are fully rendered before capturing the next observation. paragraphs.en: For each model, we construct trajectories for the corresponding tasks in each benchmark. We then create an annotated dataset by selecting potential starting steps within each trajectory, while filtering out trajectories containing multiple actions within a single step or erroneous trajectories in which actions are missing from the agent output, as such cases can complicate the annotation process. Subsequently, the action sequences from each trajectory are replayed consecutively, and we retain only the trajectories that achieve a successful oracle evaluation in three consecutive replays (N=3) to minimize the effect from environment stochasticity (Transition-Consistent Filtering). This process empirically ensures deterministic transition dynamics, resulting in a filtered evaluation set in which the starting step of each trajectory is guaranteed to exhibit consistent transitions while retaining 64.4% of recovery trajectories (Table 6 ). For OsWorld short-horizon evaluation settings using GPT-5.4-CUA, we randomly sample 600 samples for perturbation after transition-consistent filtering to keep the API computational cost manageable prior to subsequent filtering stage (Trajectory Perturbation).
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个模型，我们为每个基准测试中的相应任务构建轨迹。 随后，我们通过在每个轨迹中选择潜在的起始步骤来构建标注数据集，同时过滤掉单一步骤中包含多个动作的轨迹，以及智能体输出中缺失动作的错误轨迹，因为这类情况会使标注过程变得复杂。 接着，每个轨迹的动作序列被连续重放，我们仅保留在连续三次重放（N=3）中均取得成功的 oracle 评估的轨迹，以最小化环境随机性的影响（Transition-Consistent Filtering）。 该过程在经验上确保了确定性的转移动力学，从而得到一个过滤后的评估集，其中每个轨迹的起始步骤被保证表现出一致的转移，同时保留了 64.4% 的恢复轨迹（表 6）。 对于使用 GPT-5.4-CUA 的 OsWorld 短程评估设置，我们在转移一致性过滤之后随机采样 600 个样本进行扰动，以便在后续过滤阶段之前将 API 计算成本控制在可管理的范围内（Trajectory Perturbation）。

paragraphs.en: Using the filtered evaluation set consisting of annotated starting steps from each trajectory, we replay the action sequences until reaching the designated starting step, while verifying that the resulting observation matches the original state. Subsequently, a perturbation agent sharing the same backbone as the forward agent is prompted (Figures 27 , 28 ) to intentionally drift the trajectory under a maximum step budget identical to the recovery distance d \mathrm{d} . For short-horizon recovery evaluation, we use a perturbation budget of 1 for all models, except GPT-5.4-CUA, for which we use a budget of 2 due to its strong tendency to generate a “take a screenshot” action as the initial step which maps to time.sleep() , even under explicit instructions. We then retain only trajectories that result in oracle failure according to the benchmark evaluators (while excluding samples that were crashed due to environmental failures or gpt verification failures). This process constructs a recovery-annotated dataset, where the original starting state serves as the target recovery state, and the final perturbed state serves as the error state.
paragraphs.zh: 使用由每条轨迹中带标注的起始步骤构成的过滤后评估集，我们回放动作序列直到到达指定的起始步骤，同时验证由此产生的观测与原始状态一致。 随后，一个与前向智能体共享同一骨干的扰动智能体会被提示（图 27、28），在与恢复距离 d \mathrm{d} 相同的最大步骤预算内故意使轨迹发生偏移。 对于短程恢复评估，我们对所有模型使用 1 的扰动预算，唯独 GPT-5.4-CUA 例外，由于其强烈倾向于生成「截屏」动作作为初始步骤（该动作映射到 time.sleep() ），即使在明确的指令下也是如此，因此我们对其使用 2 的预算。 然后，我们仅保留那些根据基准评估器判定为 oracle 失败的轨迹（同时排除因环境故障或 gpt 验证失败而崩溃的样本）。 这一过程构建了一个带恢复标注的数据集，其中原始起始状态作为目标恢复状态，最终的受扰状态作为错误状态。

paragraphs.en: Finally, using the recovery-annotated dataset, we exclude problematic samples whose perturbation trajectories generate multiple actions within a single step or fail to produce actions at arbitrary steps, as such cases complicate annotation. For short-horizon recovery evaluation, we additionally remove samples without meaningful perturbation actions, such as time.sleep() or WAIT . For GPT-5.4-CUA, we exclusively retain samples where the first action is “take a screenshot” and the second action corresponds to an actual perturbation action, due to its strong tendency to begin trajectories with screenshot actions. Furthermore, we remove samples where the error state and target recovery state show significantly high similarity, while also assuring that duplicate samples with both same error state observation and target recovery state observation do not exist, adopting SSIM as core mechanism. After filtering, we randomly sample evaluation subsets. For short-horizon evaluation in OSWorld, we sample 120 instances for all models except UI-TARS-1.5-7B, for which we sample 60 due to the limited number of remaining trajectories. For long-horizon evaluation, we sample 80 instances for Qwen-3.5-9B and EvoCUA-32B, 60 for Claude-Sonnet-4.6, and UI-TARS-1.5-7B. Finally for WindowsAgentArena, we sample 70 instances for Claude-Sonnet-4.6 and GPT-5.4-CUA, and 50 for EvoCUA-32B and Qwen-3.5-9B, due to the different number of remaining samples after the filtering process.

paragraphs.en: We use the evaluation sets constructed in Section A.1 to measure the recovery success rates of both implicit and explicit recovery policies, where the annotated evaluation sets are instantiated in both OSWorld and WindowsAgentArena, where we set the environment settings identical with Section A.1 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 A.1 节中构建的评估集来衡量隐式恢复策略和显式恢复策略的恢复成功率，其中标注的评估集在 OSWorld 和 WindowsAgentArena 中均进行了实例化，并且我们将环境设置设置为与 A.1 节相同。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate both implicit and explicit recovery using the five models described in Section A.1 . paragraphs.en: For implicit recovery strategies, we provide the full history of observation–action pairs up to the error state, allowing the forward agent to infer the underlying state transitions, similar to real-world settings where agents interact continuously throughout the trajectory. In contrast, for explicit recovery strategies, we provide policies with various recovery contexts, including the observation–action history up to the error state and the target recovery state, which we denote as 0-E and 0-R , respectively. We additionally consider settings where such observations are not provided, as well as settings where the observation–action pairs up to the goal state are summarized by an LLM contextualizer that generates a compact description of the target recovery state and the transitions leading to it. When constructing observation–action histories, we maintain aligned observation–action pairs and exclude the final observation resulting from the last action, since new observation is input as current observation. The only exception is GPT-5.4-CUA, for which the final observation is included in the history due to proprietary API technical constraints.
paragraphs.zh: 对于隐式恢复策略，我们提供直到错误状态的完整观察–动作对历史，让前向智能体推断潜在的状态转移，这类似于现实世界中智能体在整个轨迹中持续交互的情形。 相比之下，对于显式恢复策略，我们为策略提供各种恢复上下文，包括直到错误状态的观察–动作历史以及目标恢复状态，我们分别将其记为 0-E 和 0-R。 我们还考虑了不提供此类观察的设置，以及由 LLM 上下文生成器总结直到目标状态的观察–动作对的设置，该生成器会生成关于目标恢复状态及通向它的转移的紧凑描述。 在构建观察–动作历史时，我们保持对齐的观察–动作对，并排除由最后一个动作产生的最终观察，因为新的观察会作为当前观察输入。 唯一的例外是 GPT-5.4-CUA，由于专有 API 的技术限制，其最终观察被包含在历史中。

paragraphs.en: In ReTrace , we evaluate recovery success along two axes: latent state recovery success and observation-wise state recovery success. For latent state recovery, we leverage our goal-oriented action replay framework, where recovery is considered unsuccessful if the benchmark oracle evaluator outputs 0 after executing the remaining actions from the ground-truth trajectory starting from the recovered state. For observation-wise recovery, we use SSIM ( Wang et al., 2004 ) with a threshold of 0.99 to detect visual mismatches that may interfere with accurate evaluation. Furthermore, in our main recovery evaluation experiments, we exclusively sample tasks that are consistently executable across all variants without docker failures or state verification failures, thereby ensuring a fair and reliable comparison of recovery success rates.
paragraphs.zh: 在 ReTrace 中，我们从两个维度评估恢复成功：潜在状态恢复成功和逐观测状态恢复成功。 对于潜在状态恢复，我们利用面向目标的动作重放框架，其中如果从恢复出的状态出发执行真实轨迹中的剩余动作后，基准 oracle 评估器输出 0，则认为恢复失败。 对于逐观测恢复，我们使用 SSIM（Wang et al., 2004）并设置 0.99 的阈值，以检测可能干扰准确评估的视觉不匹配。 此外，在我们的主要恢复评估实验中，我们只采样在所有变体上都能一致执行、没有 docker 失败或状态验证失败的任务，从而确保对恢复成功率的比较公平且可靠。

paragraphs.en: For each instance and each condition, we draw five independent continuations from the selected recovery state, and report Success@ K \mathrm{K} for K ∈ { 1 , … , 5 } \mathrm{K}\in\{1,\ldots,5\} . Each continuation begins with action-prefix replay to reconstruct the recovery state; because replay can occasionally desynchronize from the saved trajectory (e.g., due to UI timing), we retry replay up to three times per continuation. Success@ K \mathrm{K} measures whether at least one of the K \mathrm{K} successfully reconstructed continuations from the same recovery state completes the task, and reflects how much of the agent’s latent task-solving ability is exposed by recovery.

paragraphs.en: We use three open-source models as the forward agent: Qwen3.5-9B ( Qwen Team, 2026a ) with thinking mode, UI-TARS-1.5-7B ( Qin et al., 2025 ) , and EvoCUA-32B ( Xue et al., 2026 ) , following the setup in Section A.1 , where default system prompts and instructions in Section A.1 are provided. For all forward agents we set max_steps to 50 50 . Temperatures are chosen from each model’s official inference recipe except for EvoCUA-32B: its default temperature of 0.0 0.0 produces deterministic outputs, which would cause the forward agent to repeat the same action when it resumes from a past state, so we set it to 0.7 0.7 to preserve action diversity after recovery. paragraphs.en: Both the error-step detector and the recovery-step detector are LLM-based and share Qwen3.6-Plus ( Qwen Team, 2026b ) as their backbone, accessed through the OpenRouter API 3 3 3 https://openrouter.ai/ with a temperature of 0.7 and custom system prompts (Figure 36 , 37 ). paragraphs.en: After recovery completes, the forward agent resumes from the recovery-step context where the message history is truncated to the recovery boundary, and a short transition string informing the agent that the environment has been recovered is prepended before the next forward decision.

paragraphs.en: When constructing the human evaluation sets, we sample recovery results from three representative models, including Claude-Sonnet-4.6, Qwen3.5-9B, and EvoCUA-32B, across both short- and long-horizon evaluation settings in OSWorld, as well as the short-horizon setting in WindowsAgentArena. We compare ReTrace against three baselines: variants of our oracle evaluator with either ℛ O \mathcal{R}_{O} or ℛ TC \mathcal{R}_{\mathrm{TC}} removed, and GPT-5.4, a state-of-the-art model with extensive computer-use knowledge. We collect cases where the evaluation decisions produced by the oracle implemented in ReTrace differ from those of the alternative evaluators, and randomly sample 50 instances for each variant, resulting in a total of 150 evaluation samples in Table 1 . For the image-wise matching evaluator, we provide only the recovery target screenshot and the screenshot after the final recovery step. For the Transition-Consistent evaluator, success is determined solely based on whether replaying the remaining actions from the recovered state successfully reaches the original task goal. For GPT-5.4, we provide the history of observation-action pairs leading up to the error step, the recovery trajectory generated by the recovery agent, the recovery target screenshot, the error-step screenshot, and the final recovered-state screenshot. GPT-5.4 is then prompted to determine whether the semantic meaning of the recovered state aligns with the target recovery state, following the same context and inputs provided to human annotators for a fair comparison (See Figure 38 for prompt details).
paragraphs.zh: 在构建人工评测集时，我们从三个代表性模型（包括 Claude-Sonnet-4.6、Qwen3.5-9B 和 EvoCUA-32B）中采样恢复结果，涵盖 OSWorld 中短时程和长时程两种评测设置，以及 WindowsAgentArena 中的短时程设置。 我们将 ReTrace 与三个基线进行比较：分别是去除了 ℛ O \mathcal{R}_{O} 或 ℛ TC \mathcal{R}_{\mathrm{TC}} 的我们的预言机评测器的变体，以及 GPT-5.4——一个具备丰富计算机使用知识的最先进模型。 我们收集 ReTrace 中实现的预言机所产生的评测决策与其他备选评测器不同的案例，并为每个变体随机采样 50 个实例，最终在表 1 中共得到 150 个评测样本。 对于基于图像匹配的评测器，我们仅提供恢复目标截图和最终恢复步骤之后的截图。 对于转移一致性评测器，成功与否仅取决于从恢复状态回放剩余动作能否成功达成原始任务目标。 对于 GPT-5.4，我们提供错误步骤之前的观察-动作对历史、由恢复智能体生成的恢复轨迹、恢复目标截图、错误步骤截图以及最终恢复状态截图。 随后提示 GPT-5.4 判断恢复状态的语义含义是否与目标恢复状态一致，其上下文和输入与提供给人工标注者的完全相同，以确保公平比较（提示词细节见图 38）。

paragraphs.en: In Figure 9 , we present the full results on WindowsAgentArena, reporting the individual recovery success rates of each policy model. These results complement the average recovery success rates of the implicit and explicit recovery variants reported in Figure 5 . paragraphs.en: The results in Table 8 show that current computer-use agents struggle to perform restorative actions across different recovery budgets. Moreover, the recovery success rates of most agents consistently decrease as the maximum number of recovery steps increases, suggesting that simply allowing more steps does not resolve their recovery limitations. paragraphs.en: To further validate the robustness of our findings, we provide an additional analysis of the recovery capabilities of state-of-the-art computer-use agents under different hyperparameter settings in Table 9 , using the Recovery Target Contextualization setting. The results consistently show that EvoCUA-32B exhibits limited recovery capability even under explicit recovery prompting, compared to UI-TARS-1.5-7B across a wide range of hyperparameter configurations. Furthermore, the recovery success rate also remains robust across diverse hyper parameter settings for EvoCUA in WindowsAgentArena (Table 10 ). This finding highlights the inherent limitation of the EvoCUA-32B post-trained model, despite being extensively trained on offline trajectory data. In other words, even with explicit recovery guidance, the model remains unable to reliably restore previous states regardless of the hyper parameter settings. paragraphs.en: In Figure 10 , we show that the trend observed in Figure 4 remains consistent across different randomly sampled recovery evaluation sets. We randomly sample two additional recovery evaluation sets for respective policy model, each containing the same number of samples as the original set, and measure the recovery success rate of each policy model on all three sets (including one used in our main experiments). We then compute the macro-average success rate across the three evaluation sets for each recovery variant of each policy model. The results closely mirror the trend observed in Figure 4 : explicit recovery instructions yield substantial gains over implicit recovery, demonstrating that current computer-use agents possess recovery capabilities but fail to reliably invoke them during inference (Finding 2, Finding 3) . Furthermore, post-trained models such as EvoCUA exhibit nearly no recovery capability, while UI-TARS shows only modest improvements with explicit recovery instructions. In contrast, generalist agents (Claude, GPT-5.4, and Qwen) exhibit substantial gains from explicit recovery instructions. These results further support our claim, suggesting that extensive post-training on one-directional task-completion trajectories may suppress or weaken the inherent recovery capabilities of computer-use agents (Finding 4) . Furthermore, in Table 8 , we show that across three randomly sampled recovery evaluation sets, current computer-use agents rarely have restorative behavior ( Finding 2 ), and its performance is robust regardless of evaluation set.

paragraphs.en: In addition, we investigate the impact of stochastic transition dynamics, such as pop-ups, rendering variations, and dynamic timestamps, on the judgments of our oracle evaluation framework. Specifically, we conduct a human study following the same protocol as in Table 1 and Appendix B.3 . Annotators are asked to determine whether a successfully recovered state differs from the target state only due to ignorable environmental variations. Since recovery failures identified by human annotators are not attributed to environmental dynamics (see the evaluation guidelines in Figure 11 ), this evaluation quantifies how often our oracle incorrectly judges a successful recovery as failure due to stochastic environmental variations. To obtain a reliable estimate, we consider only cases where both annotators agree on a judgment on both recovery success and environmental effect. From these cases, we sample instances where the human judgment disagrees with ReTrace , and both agree that there exists stochastic environmental dynamics. Finally, we eliminate the same recovery evaluation set distributed across the independent evaluation sets (GPT-5.4 evaluator, w/o ℛ O \mathcal{R}_{\mathrm{O}} , w/o ℛ TC \mathcal{R}_{\mathrm{TC}} ) from Table 1 and compute micro-average ratio. The results in Table 11 show that ReTrace is largely robust to stochastic environmental dynamics: 86.0% of the ReTrace judgments were favorable decisions unaffected by stochastic environmental dynamics. Furthermore, since this analysis is performed on a challenging subset consisting exclusively of disagreement cases between different oracles, the overall adverse effect of stochastic environmental dynamics on the judgments of ReTrace is expected to be even smaller in practice.

The results in Table 12 demonstrate that the joint use of two oracles provides complementary strength and that the combination of them yields higher agreement with human judgments than either oracle alone, compared to utilizing each oracle in isolation, further indicating that even in disagreement situations, ReTrace can provide objective evaluation results.

sents.en: Specifically, we sample disagreement cases between ℛ O \mathcal{R}_{\mathrm{O}} and ℛ TC \mathcal{R}_{\mathrm{TC}} from the human evaluation sets (Tables 1 and 11 ).

sents.en: Following the protocol in Table 11 , we consider only samples for which both human annotators within each evaluation subset agree on a recovery success evaluation.

sents.en: We then measure the agreement rate between human judgments and oracle decisions when using ℛ O \mathcal{R}_{\mathrm{O}} , and ℛ TC \mathcal{R}_{\mathrm{TC}} alone, and both oracles jointly, among such samples using the micro-average protocol demonstrated in Table 11 .

sents.en: The results in Table 12 demonstrate that the joint use of two oracles provides complementary strength and that the combination of them yields higher agreement with human judgments than either oracle alone, compared to utilizing each oracle in isolation, further indicating that even in disagreement situations, ReTrace can provide objective evaluation results.

paragraphs.en: Finally, we analyze the sensitivity of ℛ O \mathcal{R}_{\mathrm{O}} to the SSIM threshold, which is set to 0.99 by default.
